description: A dark plum noble outer robe with wide gold embroidered borders and an over-shoulder drape sits over a full-length ivory tunic. The tunic has fine patterned round collar, cuff and hem bands. A small jeweled shoulder clasp secures the drape; a brown belt with round buckle sits at the waist. Brown leather boots appear below the layered hems. One hand rests at the belt and the other hangs visibly at the side.
